eventTime.description: The time the event is generated.

dataVersion.description: The schema version of the data object.

metadataVersion.description: The schema version of the event metadata.

topic.description: The full resource path to the event source.

subject.description: The path describing what resource the event belongs to.

deadLetterReason.description: The reason why the event was dead‑lettered.

lastDeliveryOutcome.description: Usually the response received from the webhook endpoint.

lastDeliveryAttemptTime.description: The date of the last delivery attempt.

data.description: The event data (see Event Messages for full description).
